note: Answers computed by SQL on spi/db/spi.sqlite. Money is IDR and an Estimate. Score: numbers within tolerance (absolute units, 0 = exact), ids and text exact (case-insensitive).

questions.question: How many spare parts are in the baseline data?
questions.sql: select count(*) from material

questions.question: How many spare parts were issued at least once?
questions.sql: select count(*) from part_profile where months_active>0

questions.question: How many spare parts never had an issue in the history?
questions.sql: select count(*) from part_profile where months_active=0

questions.question: How many issue transactions are in the history?
questions.sql: select count(*) from movement

questions.question: What is the first month and the last month of the consumption history?
questions.sql: select min(month)||' to '||max(month) from movement

questions.question: How many spare parts serve equipment of criticality S?
questions.sql: select count(*) from part_profile where crit_max='S'

questions.question: How many spare parts serve equipment of criticality A?
questions.sql: select count(*) from part_profile where crit_max='A'

questions.question: How many stock items are at zero stock?
questions.sql: select count(*) from part_profile p join material m using(material_no) where m.mrp_type='Stock Item' and p.stock=0

questions.question: How many stock items are below their Min but above zero?
questions.sql: select count(*) from part_profile p join material m using(material_no) where m.mrp_type='Stock Item' and p.min_qty>0 and p.stock<p.min_qty and p.stock>0

questions.question: How many parts have stock above their Max (with a Max set)?
questions.sql: select count(*) from part_profile where max_qty>0 and stock>max_qty

questions.question: What is the total stock value of parts with a usable price, in IDR bn (Estimate)?
questions.sql: select round(sum(stock_value_idr)/1e9,1) from part_profile

questions.question: What is the excess stock value above Max for parts with a Max set, in IDR bn (Estimate)?
questions.sql: select round(sum(excess_value_idr)/1e9,1) from part_profile where max_qty>0

questions.question: Which part has the largest excess value (material number)?
questions.sql: select material_no from part_profile order by excess_value_idr desc limit 1

questions.question: Which part has the highest stock value (material number)?
questions.sql: select material_no from part_profile order by stock_value_idr desc limit 1

questions.question: Which part was issued in the most months (material number)?
questions.sql: select material_no from part_profile order by months_active desc, total_qty desc limit 1

questions.question: Which part has the largest total issued quantity (material number)?
questions.sql: select material_no from part_profile order by total_qty desc limit 1

questions.question: What is the median purchase lead time in days (PR date to PO delivery, valid lines only)?
questions.sql: select cast(round(avg(lead_days)) as integer) from (select lead_days from po_line where lead_days>0 and lead_days<=365 order by lead_days limit 2 - (select count(*) from po_line where lead_days>0 and lead_days<=365) % 2 offset (select (count(*)-1)/2 from po_line where lead_days>0 and lead_days<=365))

questions.question: How many PO lines have a lead time above 365 days?
questions.sql: select count(*) from po_line where lead_days>365

questions.question: How many different suppliers are in the purchase history?
questions.sql: select count(distinct supplier_code) from po_line

questions.question: Which supplier has the most PO lines?
questions.sql: select supplier from po_line group by supplier order by count(*) desc limit 1

questions.question: How many maintenance notifications have priority Emergency?
questions.sql: select count(*) from notification where priority='Emergency'

questions.question: How many maintenance notifications are still In Progress?
questions.sql: select count(*) from notification where status='In Progress'

questions.question: How many planned maintenance items fall due in the 12 months after the data cut-off?
questions.sql: select count(*) from maint_item where next_due between (select value from meta where key='data_cutoff') and date((select value from meta where key='data_cutoff'),'+12 months')

questions.question: How many parts have an intermittent demand pattern?
questions.sql: select count(*) from part_profile where demand_class='intermittent'

questions.question: How many parts have a lumpy demand pattern?
questions.sql: select count(*) from part_profile where demand_class='lumpy'

questions.question: How many parts were issued in only one month?
questions.sql: select count(*) from part_profile where demand_class='single_event'

questions.question: How many parts are insurance spare candidates (no demand, S or A equipment, lead time above 90 days or unknown)?
questions.sql: select count(*) from part_profile where months_active=0 and crit_max in ('S','A') and (lt_median is null or lt_median>90)

questions.question: How many stock items are non-moving (stock on hand, no issue in the history)?
questions.sql: select count(*) from part_profile p join material m using(material_no) where m.mrp_type='Stock Item' and p.months_active=0 and p.stock>0

questions.question: How many Non Stock materials still hold stock?
questions.sql: select count(*) from part_profile p join material m using(material_no) where m.mrp_type='Non Stock' and p.stock>0

questions.question: How many functional locations have no criticality?
questions.sql: select count(*) from funcloc where criticality is null

questions.question: How many spare parts are installed on equipment KT-383A?
questions.sql: select count(*) from bom where funcloc='PX_KT-383A'

questions.question: How many notifications are recorded on location PX_BF-110?
questions.sql: select count(*) from notification where funcloc='PX_BF-110'
